Ramp Economics Lab / Ara Kharazian. Captured October 23, 2026. https://ramp.com/data/ai-index
Monthly prices are token-weighted averages of nonoverlapping weeks ending in that month; they are not exact calendar-month billing averages.
October covers weeks ending October 4 and 11. November/December price and mix assumptions carry October forward; ARR follows the source forecast.
Minimum reference = lower monthly published ratio or matched-model ratio. Denominators remain unresolved; neither is a validated company ASP.
Full ARR conversion is API-equivalent demand. It does not measure subscription usage, free users, training tokens or actual company token consumption.
Matched models have positive tokens and a reported spending record. Missing spending remains unknown; unmatched volume is excluded from matched prices.
Net ARR mode is a revenue-equivalent scenario. Ramp spend ratios are not automatically net of cloud revenue sharing or discounts.
Raw observations: tokenPrices and tokenVolumes, Ramp chart-data version b1ACnM4ULJjULGFdkttsRs.
Family allocation is an illustrative transfer of Ramp mix to company-level implied demand, not an independent estimate of actual product traffic.
Gross/net alternatives and forecasts in the source are preserved. No official ARR marks are substituted and no source-workbook errors are repaired.
Independent company token-volume validation: unavailable. The revenue/price identity verifies arithmetic only.
Denominator disagreement remains visible on Minimum price. Source row agreement does not establish recognized revenue or a common customer universe.
